subject: reasoning
question:
Two different positions of the same dice are shown, the six faces of which are marked as A, B, C, D, E, F. Select the letter that will be on the face opposite to the one showing 'B'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6bbccb7fb5d1f938e6121243ae968ae7336217a8d8de5d499c3761e5289cf11e.png]
solution:
Here, we are given two dices and two faces of both the dices are same. So, we will rotate the second dice so that it is same as the first dice. 

So, we have:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/69ed9ed8d2e7a6c8117e990477e38743f1e3898b95dd9c8d597a26df04db9992.png] 

From that, we can say that face C is opposite to face B.

Thus, the letter __**C**__ will be on the face opposite to the one showing B.

 

Hence, the correct answer is '__**option 3**__'.
